previous_assumption: Assumed a Renter had no reason to call listRentals directly — Rentals nav item was gated rental.manage-only (Rental Company), and a Renter had no way to see the machines currently on rent to them.
correction: Added a new rental.respond permission (renter, read-only), mirroring the existing quotation.manage/.respond and billing.manage/.respond split exactly (migration 0017, seeded to the owner role same as the others). RentalService.listRentals now branches on the caller org's type: Rental Company keeps listByOrganization (unchanged); Renter gets listByRenterOrganization plus server-side resolved machineAssetCode/rentalCompanyOrganizationName (Rental contract gained these two nullable fields, populated only on the renter branch — same "resolve server-side, don't grant the underlying permission" shape already used for auction bids' rentalCompanyOrganizationName). Renter never had equipment.manage on the Rental Company's org, so it can't resolve these itself.
